lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Pour a splash (about 6 ml) of your racked wine onto the Watch Glass and judge its clarity against the light.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Pour about 12 ml into the Tasting Glass and evaluate the aroma and flavour.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Review your wine, then answer on the data sheet.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Carry the Florence flask INTO the fume hood, then squeeze 2 dropper-loads of aniline into it there.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Squeeze 2 dropper-loads of glacial acetic acid into the flask.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: In the fume hood, squeeze 2 dropper-loads of acetyl chloride in, then warm the flask at the water bath (~5 min).

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Tilt-pour about 20 ml of distilled water into the flask, then set it in the ice bucket.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Hold the funnel over the Beaker 100 mL and tilt-pour the flask through it.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Into Test Tube 11: 1 scoopula of your crystals + 3 squeezes of concentrated HCl, then boil it at the water bath.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Tube 12: 1 scoopula of crystals + 5 water + 1 of 0.1N HCl + 5 bromine water. Tube 13: 2 aniline (fume hood!) + 5 water + 1 of 0.1N HCl + 2 bromine water.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Review the results, then answer on the data sheet.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Set the HARD-GLASS tube on the balance, then scoop each acetate in until the balance passes 7 g - about 4 scoopula dips of each.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Light a burner and hold the tube over its flame until it reaches a red-glow 150 °C.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Keep Test Tube 14 close to the hot tube's mouth; the distillate collects there while the tube stays hot.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Test Tube 15: 2 of your acetone + 5 water + 2 squeezes of silver nitrate.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Test Tube 16: 5 squeezes of Schiff's reagent + 2 of your acetone; let it stand.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Test Tube 17: 10 of KI + 2 of your acetone + 10 of hypochlorite, then warm it at the water bath.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Test Tube 18: 1 of ethanol + 2 of sodium bisulfite + 1 of your acetone, then set it in the ice bucket.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Tilt-pour about 40 ml of it into the Beaker 500 mL.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Squeeze 2 dropper-loads of benzaldehyde into the beaker, then warm the beaker at the water bath (pour distilled water in, lit burner beside it).

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Hold the funnel over the Erlenmeyer flask and tilt-pour the beaker through it (about 20 ml).

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Squeeze 5 dropper-loads of 6N hydrochloric acid into the flask.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Set the flask in the ice bucket and let it chill.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Scoop 1 scoopula of your crystals (2 g) into Test Tube 8, add 2 squeezes of distilled water, then touch a litmus strip to it.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Into Test Tube 9: 1 scoopula of crystals, 2 squeezes of 10% NaOH, then 5 squeezes of ferric chloride.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Into Test Tube 10: 1 scoopula of crystals, 10 squeezes of propyl alcohol, 1 of sulfuric acid — then warm it at the water bath.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Erlenmeyer Flask 400 mL: scoop 5 scoopula dips of bleaching powder in FIRST, then tilt-pour distilled water to 20 ml.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Graduated Cylinder 50 mL: tilt-pour acetone to 5 ml, then a 10 ml tilt-pour of distilled water.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Dropper 5 squeezes of the acetone mix into the flask, then warm the flask to 40 °C at the water bath — watch the dense chloroform form.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Keep the flask in the water bath (lit burner beside it) until its label reads 65 °C.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Hold Beaker 100 mL beside the hot flask — 8 ml of crude chloroform run over.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Squeeze 4 of distilled water into Beaker 100 mL and swirl — the next step decants the bottom layer off.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Decant (tilt-pour) 8 ml of the dense chloroform into the Distilling Flask, add 1 scoopula of anhydrous calcium chloride, then warm it to 65 °C at the bath.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Keep the Distilling Flask hot; hold Test Tube 14 at its mouth until 6 ml run over clear.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Set Test Tube 14 on the balance and let the reading settle.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Pour 2 ml (4 tilt-pours) of your chloroform onto the Watch Glass, then strike a match and hold the flame to it.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Test Tube 15 in the hood: 2 tilt-pours of your chloroform, 4 spatula dips of potassium dichromate, 2 squeezes of sulfuric acid — then warm it at the water bath.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Test Tube 16: 1 squeeze of alcoholic silver nitrate FIRST, then 2 tilt-pours of your chloroform. Warm it at the water bath and watch for the white precipitate.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Dropper = 1 squeeze per ml: one squeeze of its OWN sample into each labelled tube, then tilt-pour distilled water to the 10 ml mark. All five tubes.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: 5 squeezes of the dropper over EVERY tube. Watch which one flashes violet - that is the enol.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: 2 squeezes of KMnO4, then 2 of Sodium Hydroxide, into all four tubes. This rack is the ALKALINE run.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: 5 squeezes into tubes 1-3, one alcohol each. Do NOT pour into tube 4 - the untouched control is part of the experiment.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Same build on the second rack, acid instead of base: 2 squeezes of KMnO4 and 2 of Sulfuric Acid into ALL FOUR tubes, then 5 of each alcohol into tubes 1-3 only - tube 4 stays alcohol-free as the control. Then compare both racks side by side.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: 2 squeezes of the sample, then 2 of Tollen's, in BOTH tubes. Only the aldehyde plates a silver mirror.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: 10 squeezes, then 4, then 1 - all three are needed; the acid is the catalyst. Then read the odour cue.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: 10 squeezes of Methanol, ONE spatula dip of Salicylic Acid (a dip = 0.1 g), 1 squeeze of acid.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: 5 spatula dips of Aspirin (0.1 g each), tilt-pour water to 10 ml, 1 squeeze of acid - then strike a match, light the burner and let it boil.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Rest the funnel on the beaker and pour the boiled mixture through it.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: 2 squeezes into the filtrate beaker.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: 5 spatula dips of Aspirin into the control tube, then 2 squeezes of Ferric Chloride. The DIFFERENCE between the two tubes is the result.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: The results board filled itself in as you worked - read it back, then answer on the data sheet.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Florence Flask: 6 scoopula dips of brown sugar, 2 scoopula dips of yeast, 1 scoopula dip of ammonium phosphate, then tilt-pour distilled water to the 20 ml band.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Pour 10 ml of limewater into Test Tube 5, then lead the delivery tube from the flask into it and watch it turn milky.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Squeeze 2 dropper-loads of 10% sodium hydroxide into the Florence Flask to bring the wash slightly alkaline.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Decant 20 ml of the fermented wash into the Distilling Flask, then warm it at the water bath until it reads 70 C.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Pour 3 ml of your distillate onto the Watch Glass, then strike a match and hold the flame to it.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Test Tube 6: 1 squeeze of your distillate, 10 squeezes of potassium iodide 10%, 5 squeezes of sodium hypochlorite - then warm it at the water bath to 60 C.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Test Tube 7: 10 squeezes of your distillate, 4 squeezes of diluted acetic acid, 1 squeeze of sulfuric acid - then warm it at the water bath.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Read the results back, then answer on the data sheet.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Scoop the sodium acetate + soda lime into the mortar, then GRAB THE PESTLE and grind in the bowl until it is a fine powder. (You do not move the powder into the tube — grinding is all this step needs.)

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Scoop the ground mixture from the mortar into the "Hard-glass tube" — this is the tube you will heat. (Ignore the bent delivery tubes; they are not used.)

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Grab a match and strike it on the matchbox, touch it to the burner to light it, then hold the lit burner under the "Hard-glass tube". Heating it makes the methane gas.

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Keep the "Gas collection tube" held against the heated "Hard-glass tube" — methane collects until the tube is full (a few seconds).

lines.speaker: Pharmee
lines.text: Light a match and bring it to the mouth of the full "Gas collection tube" — methane pops and burns with a pale blue flame. Test complete!
